title: Did you know… Joshua encountered a mysterious commander before battle?
paragraphs: Did you know… Joshua encountered a mysterious commander before battle?

He was about to step into war…
but heaven stepped into him first.
Joshua saw a Man.
Not just any man.

Sword drawn.
Eyes like fire.
Standing in silence between fear and victory.
Joshua 5:13–15.
Before Jericho ever fell… Joshua fell on his face.
“Are you for us… or for our enemies?”
And the answer?
“No.”

Not yes.
Not no.
“But as Commander of the army of the Lord I have now come.”
Pause there.

God didn’t come to take sides.
He came to take over.
And Joshua realized—this battle was never his to control.
So he did the only thing a true warrior does…
He worshipped.
But here’s what we miss.

We love asking, “God, are You on my side?”
But heaven asks back, “Are you on Mine?”

Because victory isn’t about God joining your agenda…
It’s about you surrendering to His authority.
That mysterious Commander?

Many believe this was a pre-incarnate appearance of Jesus Christ.
Not a messenger.
The Commander.

The One who fights for you…
but first demands your surrender.

Before walls fall…
pride must fall.

Before breakthrough…
there must be bowing.
Joshua didn’t win because he was strong.
He won because he knelt.
And maybe that’s your word today.

You’ve been trying to win battles
God never asked you to lead.

You’ve been swinging swords
without first hearing His voice.
Stop.
Look up.
The Commander is here.

And He’s not asking for your strength—
He’s asking for your surrender.
Lay it down.

Your plans.
Your control.
Your hidden fears.

Because when Jesus leads…
walls don’t stand a chance.

From battle to bowing—
because Jesus never loses a war.
